estimand: Occurrence-level candidate-minus-local-party share, net of the party-election matched-contest candidate-versus-party offset excluding this occurrence's contest.
units: fractions internally; diagnostic distributions in percentage points
inputClass: observed election results only, on each election's actual geography
eligibility: Held contest, valid distinct candidate/party denominators, exact within-election affiliation counterpart. Preserve excluded nominations with reasons. Source-report groupings do not establish identity.
referenceUniverse: All eligible general and Maori contests for the same election and party; identical contest universe for candidate and party aggregates.
leaveOneOut: Subtract the entire focal contest's candidate/party numerators and respective denominators. Require at least two eligible contests before subtraction; otherwise normalized residual is null and raw premium is retained.

formulas.log_odds: OR=C_ref_minus_i*(1-P_ref_minus_i)/(P_ref_minus_i*(1-C_ref_minus_i)); expected=p*OR/(1-p+p*OR), provided both reference shares lie strictly between zero and one

boundsPolicy: Preserve raw additive/proportional expected values and residuals. Also expose bounded expected values and out-of-range flags. No silent clipping or pseudocounts.
selectionRule: Retain additive unless material broadly systematic pathology appears. Inspect all groups, scope/major-party distributions, reference coverage, out-of-range/undefined cases and share correlations. Do not optimize correlations or fit another model.
coveragePolicy: Only hard minimum is two matched contests. Store quantitative slate coverage and denominators; no further selection threshold.
antiLeakage: Each reference uses the same election only and excludes the focal contest. No future outcomes, synthetic candidate baselines, person links/statuses, polling or 2026 inputs.
interpretation: Descriptive residual, not candidate quality, persistent personal vote, causal effect or forecast bonus.
dependencies: Stage6 remains a provisional response component. No target-geography transport or additive stacking of overlapping effects. Person/history/status infrastructure begins only in the later authorized persistence stage.
